scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @prepford/web --if-present && npm run build --workspace @prepford/api --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @prepford/web --if-present && npm run test --workspace @prepford/api --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: cd apps/api && dotnet test Tests/Preform.Api.Tests.csproj --filter FullyQualifiedName~Integration
scripts.db:generate: cd apps/api && dotnet ef migrations bundle --output ../migrate --self-contained || echo 'EF Core tools required: dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef'
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && dotnet ef database update
scripts.db:deploy: cd apps/api && dotnet ef database update
